independent_recompute.SHA256SUMS_self_coverage_note: Expected and unavoidable: a file cannot contain its own hash. SHA256SUMS.txt is therefore the packet's root of trust, anchored externally by the commission-supplied manifest digest recorded below.

circularity_deviation_ruling.noviymac_claim: 00_RETURN.md is omitted from manifest.files[] because it records the manifest's own SHA-256; including it would create a hash circularity with no fixed point. SHA256SUMS.txt covers both.
reviewer_analysis: The claim is factually correct. A hash-binding file cannot contain its own digest, and 00_RETURN.md quotes the manifest digest, so listing 00_RETURN.md inside the manifest is unsatisfiable.

A complete non-circular chain does exist. SHA256SUMS.txt binds all 9 final files including 00_RETURN.md and 08_PACKET_MANIFEST.json. 00_RETURN.md records the manifest digest. The manifest binds the 7 extraction outputs and the prohibition counters. Every edge was independently verified exact by this reviewer.

The chain has one unanchored root: SHA256SUMS.txt is not bound by anything inside the packet. That is normal for a checksum file, and here it is anchored EXTERNALLY because the commission supplied the manifest digest out of band and this reviewer reproduced it exactly.
No hash in the packet is stale. No file needed repair and none was rewritten.

checkpoint_body_absent_on_starriymac.consequence: The 3404445161-byte checkpoint document is NOT available on StarriyMac, so this reviewer could NOT independently recompute its SHA-256 or byte length. Only the packet's consistent REPORTING of those values could be reviewed.
